import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0124.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=0.093,4.575,60.0
hr=math.radians(h); F=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); Rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3), round(D,2)
gray=(abs(R-G)<14)&(B>R+8)&(R>90)&(R<160)
floor=(R>130)&(R<200)&(B<G)&((R-B)>10)
cols=[u for u in range(512) if gray[:,u].sum()>5]
print('gray cols',cols[0],cols[-1],len(cols))
for u in range(cols[0],cols[-1]+1,12):
    c=np.nonzero(gray[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)<5: continue
    print(' u',u,'vtop',c.min(),'vbot',c.max(),'base',bp(u,c.max()))
print('--- floor junction')
for u in range(4,512,40):
    c=np.nonzero(floor[:,u])[0]; c=c[c>258]
    if len(c)>20: print(' u',u,'v',c.min(),bp(u,c.min()))
EOF
